description: RETIRED — extended thinking is now controlled by Claude's smart routing. Forcing it always-on caused 5-10 minute response times on every request, including trivial ones. Users who want always-on thinking can set CLAUDE_CODE_ALWAYS_ENABLE_EFFORT=1 manually.
retired_reason: Forces extended thinking on every request regardless of complexity, causing multi-minute delays on simple tasks. Smart routing (CLAUDE_CODE_SMART_ROUTING=1) already enables thinking when needed.
